title.zh: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收
title.en: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收

current_state.zh: 韩国政府正寻求将加密资产收益税推迟至2029年，并研究亏损结转及推进相关立法；此前总统办公室已决定再次推迟原定于2027年1月实施的征税。
current_state.en: South Korea's government is seeking to postpone the crypto gains tax to 2029, while studying loss carryforwards and advancing related legislation; this follows the presidential office's earlier decision to again delay the tax originally set for January 2027.

updates.title_zh: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收
updates.title_en: 韩国推迟原定于明年1月实施的加密资产所得税征收
updates.what_changed_zh: 韩国总统办公室决定再次推迟原定于2027年1月生效的加密资产所得税，理由是CARF信息交换时间表尚未确定，并担心过早征税会将负担集中到国内交易所用户身上。
updates.what_changed_en: South Korea's presidential office has decided to again postpone the crypto asset income tax originally set to take effect in January 2027, citing the pending CARF information-exchange timeline and concerns that taxing early would concentrate the burden on domestic exchange users.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️韩国拟将加密货币收益税推迟两年至2029年，或允许亏损结转抵扣
updates.title_en: ⚡️韩国拟将加密货币收益税推迟两年至2029年，或允许亏损结转抵扣
updates.what_changed_zh: 韩国财政部长李炯一表示，政府计划将22%的加密资产收益税再推迟两年至2029年，并将与国会协商推进立法；政府还计划研究允许三年亏损结转抵扣，并推动数字资产法案。若获批，这将是自2020年以来第四次推迟。
updates.what_changed_en: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il said the government will seek to delay the 22% crypto gains tax by two years to 2029 and will consult the National Assembly on legislation; it will also study allowing three-year loss carryforwards and push a digital asset bill. If approved, this would be the fourth postponement since 2020.
updates.current_state_zh: 韩国政府正寻求将加密资产收益税推迟至2029年，并研究亏损结转及推进相关立法；此前总统办公室已决定再次推迟原定于2027年1月实施的征税。
updates.current_state_en: South Korea's government is seeking to postpone the crypto gains tax to 2029, while studying loss carryforwards and advancing related legislation; this follows the presidential office's earlier decision to again delay the tax originally set for January 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: South Korea's finance minister said the government will seek to delay the start of its 22% crypto gains tax by two years to 2029, citing the 2029 US tax-information exchange, and will study allowing three-year loss carryforwards alongside new tax rules and a digital asset bill.
updates.detailed_summary_en: South Korea's finance minister said the government will seek to delay the start of its 22% crypto gains tax by two years to 2029, citing the 2029 US tax-information exchange, and will study allowing three-year loss carryforwards alongside new tax rules and a digital asset bill.
